[[Club Sport Emelec|Emelec]] successfully defended their title, winning their third consecutive championship and 13th overall. ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in the 2015 Serie A season, ten of which remained from the previous season. [[Manta Fútbol Club|Manta]] and [[Centro Deportivo Olmedo|Olmedo]] were relegated from the Serie A after finishing with the fewest points in the [[2014 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2014 season]]. They were replaced by [[Sociedad Deportiva Aucas|Aucas]] and [[Club Deportivo River Plate Ecuador|River Plate]], the 2014 Serie B winner and runner-up, respectively.
